# 1 · Apple account

Apple only lets you install an app you built if it knows who you are. This step is signing in with an
Apple account. If you already have an Apple Developer account, use it and skip to
[Step 2](xcode.md).

## Free or paid

<div class="grid cards" markdown>

- **Free** <span class="cx2-tag now">start here</span>

    ---

    Costs nothing. The app stops opening after **7 days**; installing it again from the Mac takes a
    minute.

- **Paid: $99 a year**

    ---

    An install lasts **a year**, and the app's most important notifications can break through Focus.

</div>

## Your Apple account

An Apple account is the email and password you use for the App Store or iCloud. On your iPhone, open
**Settings**: if your name is at the top, you have one. If not, tap **Sign in to your iPhone** and create
one.

Apple requires **two-factor authentication** for building apps. Turn it on if it asks.

## Free path: you're done

Xcode signs you in with your Apple account in [Step 2](xcode.md). There's nothing else to do here.

## Paid path: enroll

<ol class="cx2-steps">
<li>Go to <a href="https://developer.apple.com/programs/enroll/">developer.apple.com/programs/enroll</a> and sign in with your Apple account.</li>
<li>Choose <strong>Individual</strong>, pay, and confirm your identity if asked (Apple may use the <strong>Apple Developer</strong> app on your iPhone for this).</li>
<li>Wait for the confirmation email. It's usually quick, sometimes up to a day.</li>
</ol>

!!! tip "You can build while you wait"
    Build with the free path now. When the paid account is ready, choose it as your team in
    [Step 3](build-app.md#your-details) and build again.
